name: budget-guidelines
desc: 分目标的储蓄/支出结构/应急金/预算规则，均带可核验出处。

50_30_20.desc: 税后收入分三份：必需 ≤50%、想要 ≤30%、储蓄/还债 ≥20%
50_30_20.note: Warren E, Tyagi A. All Your Worth: The Ultimate Lifetime Money Plan. Free Press; 2005.

emergency_fund.desc: 先备 1 个月，再补到 3-6 个月开支；优先级高于投资
emergency_fund.note: 美联储家庭经济福祉报告显示相当比例家庭拿不出小额应急金（Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System. Report on the Economic Well-Being of U.S. Households. 2019）。

save_rate.desc: 储蓄率是财务健康最核心的单一指标；低于 10% 视为警戒
save_rate.note: 与 50/30/20 的 20% 储蓄线一致（Warren & Tyagi 2005）。

fixed_expense.desc: 固定支出占比建议 ≤50%，过高会削弱抗风险能力
fixed_expense.note: 与 50/30/20 的必需上限一致（Warren & Tyagi 2005）。

automation.desc: 用制度代替意志力：发薪日自动转出、涨薪时自动提高储蓄额
automation.note: Thaler RH, Benartzi S. Save more tomorrow. J Polit Econ. 2004;112(S1):S164-S187.

cooling_off.desc: 大额非必需消费设 24 小时冷静期，对冲冲动与支付痛感钝化
cooling_off.note: Prelec D, Loewenstein G. The red and the black. Mark Sci. 1998;17(1):4-28；Feinberg RA. Credit cards as spending facilitating stimuli. J Consum Res. 1986;12(3):348-356.

behavioural_traps.name: 心理账户
behavioural_traps.desc: 把钱按来源/用途分袋，导致该省的不省
behavioural_traps.note: Thaler RH. Mental accounting and consumer choice. Mark Sci. 1985;4(3):199-214.

behavioural_traps.name: 双曲贴现
behavioural_traps.desc: 过度偏好眼前满足，储蓄计划一再推迟
behavioural_traps.note: Laibson D. Golden eggs and hyperbolic discounting. Q J Econ. 1997;112(2):443-477.

behavioural_traps.name: 沉没成本
behavioural_traps.desc: 因为已花钱而继续投入（如闲置会员、烂尾项目）
behavioural_traps.note: Arkes HR, Blumer C. The psychology of sunk cost. Organ Behav Hum Decis Process. 1985;35(1):124-140.

behavioural_traps.name: 锚定效应
behavioural_traps.desc: 第一个价格成为参照，'打折'感觉便宜
behavioural_traps.note: Tversky A, Kahneman D. Judgment under uncertainty. Science. 1974;185(4157):1124-1131.

behavioural_traps.name: 享乐适应
behavioural_traps.desc: 收入上涨后欲望同步上涨，永远不够
behavioural_traps.note: Brickman P, Campbell DT. Hedonic relativism and planning the good society. 1971；Easterlin RA. 1974.
